result: I would implement comprehensive environmental education in all levels of schooling, beginning from an early age, to foster a deep-seated understanding and responsibility towards the planet. The objective would be to raise a generation of individuals who are conscious of their footprint on the Earth and the importance of maintaining it. Studying would no longer be purely theoretical, but practical, involving regular exposure to nature, hands-on learning experiences, and an intrinsic knowledge of the interdependence of all life forms and their ecosystems, leading to sustainable living derived from an early age. This hope is that future adults will feel disturbed by disrespect to the ecosystem, hence causing a worldwide, monumental shift towards sustainable living, cutting the current rampant pollution, deforestation, and disregard for nature by creating a balanced society that lives in harmony with the Earth.
